title: MIMI ↔ Marmot bridge
description: Bridge MIMI rooms and Marmot (White Noise) groups: a front end in mimid-agent (crate mimid-agent-marmot, name not final) that drives MDK's wn-agent over its marmot.agent-control.v2 socket, relay mode first, then puppet mode on a multi-user host. Design note: docs/design/marmot-bridge.md, following option (b) of docs/design/nostr-comparison.md. Mark's decisions on the note's twelve open questions (2026-11-21) are in its §10, 'Decisions (Mark, 2026-11-21)', applied on branch bridge-decisions (commit 1c2b6eba, not merged yet). The step plan is §9; each step is a child bead. WG issue drafts (not posted, need Mark's OK): IETF repo notes/draft-room-policy-bot-user.md and notes/draft-mimi-content-on-behalf-of.md.
